findings.title: Order status transition routes in order-service lack authentication middleware
findings.description: statusTransitions.ts and receive.ts in order-service do NOT apply authenticate or requireStoreAccess middleware. Any request bypassing the gateway can transition order statuses and receive goods without authentication.
findings.impact: Defense-in-depth violation. If order-service port is accessible within VPC, unauthenticated requests can submit/cancel/confirm/ship orders and record GRN entries.
findings.recommendation: Add router.use(authenticate); router.use(requireStoreAccess); at the top of both files, matching purchaseOrders.ts pattern.

findings.title: GRN service calls non-existent inventory-service endpoint POST /stores/:storeId/stock
findings.description: grnService.ts calls POST /stores/${storeId}/stock but inventory-service has no such route. Available routes are /stores/:storeId/inventory/transactions and /internal/stock/:storeId/batch. GRN will always get 404.
findings.impact: Entire GRN goods receiving flow is non-functional. Stock never updates when retailer receives goods from purchase orders.
findings.recommendation: Change grnService.ts to call /stores/${storeId}/inventory/transactions with transactionType: 'purchase_received'. Align payload format (adjustmentQty -> items[].quantity).

findings.title: Supplier status transition state machine differs from order-service state machine
findings.description: Two independent state machines: order-service allows shipped->partial_received, supplier route omits partial_received entirely and includes nonexistent 'pending' status.
findings.impact: Supplier cannot interact with partially received orders. Duplicate state machines will diverge further over time.
findings.recommendation: Extract validTransitions into shared package. Remove duplicate definition from supplier route.

findings.title: Supplier order status update bypasses order-service outbox and event logging
findings.description: Supplier status changes do not write to the outbox. Downstream event consumers (reorder-service, analytics) miss supplier-initiated status changes.
findings.impact: Async workflows for supplier confirm/ship/cancel events will not fire.
findings.recommendation: Refactor supplier route to call statusService.transitionStatus() or add outbox writes.

findings.title: POS canReceive() allows 'confirmed' status but backend only allows 'shipped' or 'partial_received'
findings.description: POS canReceive() includes 'confirmed' but backend rejects GRN for confirmed orders.
findings.impact: POS shows 'Receive Goods' button for confirmed orders but tap always fails with backend error.
findings.recommendation: Remove 'confirmed' from POS canReceive() to match backend.

findings.title: Retailer admin purchase order status enum missing 4 of 7 backend statuses
findings.description: Retailer-admin knows only 4 statuses (pending, confirmed, delivered, cancelled). Missing: draft, submitted, shipped, partial_received. Includes nonexistent 'pending'.
findings.impact: Orders in shipped/submitted/partial_received states have no color, no filter option in retailer admin.
findings.recommendation: Update to complete 7-status enum matching backend.

findings.title: Supplier delivery-confirm skips GRN flow, marks delivered without inventory update
findings.description: Supplier delivery-confirm directly sets status to 'delivered' without triggering GRN, inventory-service call, or receive_record creation.
findings.impact: Orders marked delivered but stock_balances not incremented. Permanent inventory understatement.
findings.recommendation: Remove supplier delivery-confirm or make it trigger GRN flow internally.

findings.title: Receive records endpoint does not enforce store isolation via storeId
findings.impact: Cross-store receive record leakage if orderId is known.
findings.recommendation: Pass storeId to getReceiveRecords() and add WHERE clause.

findings.title: Order events endpoint does not enforce store isolation
findings.description: GET /stores/:storeId/orders/:orderId/events ignores storeId, leaks order event history cross-store.
findings.impact: Order event history (status transitions, timestamps) accessible cross-store.
findings.recommendation: Pass storeId to getOrderEvents() and validate order belongs to store.

findings.title: Supplier can set received_quantity on items without triggering inventory adjustment
findings.description: PATCH supplier item status endpoint allows setting receivedQuantity directly in DB without inventory-service call or receive_record.
findings.impact: purchase_order_items.received_quantity > 0 but stock_balances shows no corresponding stock. Permanent data inconsistency.
findings.recommendation: Remove receivedQuantity from supplier item status endpoint. Only set via GRN flow.

findings.title: POS sends unitPrice in create order but backend silently ignores it with no price-change warning
findings.description: POS sends unitPrice in cart items, backend uses snapshot prices. No warning when prices differ.
findings.impact: Order total may differ from what POS user expected if supplier changed prices between cart and submit.
findings.recommendation: Add server-side price comparison and return warning field in response if prices changed.

findings.title: Three surfaces return purchase orders with different field names and response shapes
findings.description: Same entity returned as orderNumber vs poNumber, totalAmount vs totalMinor, different pagination formats across 3 endpoints.
findings.impact: Three frontends must maintain different parsing logic for the same data.
findings.recommendation: Create shared order DTO transformer. Standardize field names and pagination format.

critical_blockers: DA6-CROSS-001: Status transition and GRN routes lack authentication
DA6-CROSS-002: GRN calls non-existent inventory endpoint -- goods receiving flow broken
